newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek stocks slip on low volume, weak construction.
newsitem.headline: Greek stocks slip on low volume, weak construction.

text.p: Tuesday's trading in the Athens bourse was spiced by fairly active block trading but the general index edged back with construction leading the market lower despite a mixed view on banks and industrials.

"We are at the peak of the summer holiday season, don't expect anything other than range trading and low volumes," said a floor trader. "Only some of the block trades executed represent underlying demand, the rest is just put-through orders for book entries."
Construction stocks were weak today on continuing concern over bank debts of a large number of stocks in the sector following liquidity problems in Atemke, the trader added.
The Athens general index slipped 0.12 percent or 1.94 points lower to 1,584.91 from Monday's 1,586.85 close, fluctuating between 1,580 and 1,590 points.
Construction lost 1.90 percent against a fairly mixed background in other sectors. Banks were down 0.10 percent and industrials gained 0.24 percent.
Turnover was a light 9.1 billion drachmas on volume of 3.6 million shares.
Blocks were traded in Alpha Credit, 44,000 shares at 19,570 drachmas, Endysi, 450,000 shares at 650, Sarantis, 57,560 shares at 3,550, and Aspis Pronia, 80,000 shares at 2,350.
Decliners beat advancers 128 to 68 with 35 shares unchanged on 231 traded.
OTE telecom Global Depository Shares (GDS) were quoted on London's SEAQ International market at $10.5-$10.8. Two GDSs make up one share of OTE.
The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas, capped at 5,000 drachmas, was quoted at 1,119-1,149 drachmas.

The recently launched second Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 6,800 drachmas, capped at 10,000 drachmas, was quoted at 1,040-1,100 drachmas. The warrants expire December 16, 1998. Shares of the underlying stock were unchanged at 6,270.
The Merrill Lynch American call warrant on a basket of 23 Greek equities that are part of the Athens general index was quoted at 628.95-669.09 drachmas. The warrants expire January 9 1998.

The ING Baring Financial Products American style call warrant based on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted at $69.46-$72.18. The strike price is set at $99.60 and the warrants expire October 8, 1997.

The ING Baring Financial Products American-style call warrant on a basket of six blue-chips denominated in drachmas was quoted at 3,419-3,640 drachmas. The strike price is set at 10,000 drachmas and the warrants expire on February 2, 1998.
The ING Baring American-style second call warrant on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted at $10.23 bid/no offer. The strike price is set at $110.0 and the warrants expire April 9 1998.

The recently launched ING Baring American-style, drachma- denominated call warrant on the bourse's benchmark index was quoted at 220-252 drachmas. The strike price is set at 1,639 points and the warrants expire May 14 1998. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
